# Pup Softlock

> Pup Softlock's personal website and navigation hub for his social profiles and European puppy-community events. He is a gay, submissive human pup based in Venlo, Netherlands.

Puppy play is part of Softlock's identity, sexuality, and everyday sense of self, rather than only a costume worn at parties. He enjoys petting, bondage and BDSM, fetish parties, and meeting other pups.

Masturbation and orgasm are rare, controlled opportunities.

Softlock is married to his husband, who is his chastity keyholder. He is also Beta to Pup Erin, his Alpha within their puppy relationship. These are distinct relationships.

Interests include puppy play, permanent chastity, tails, bondage and BDSM, toys, e-stim, fetish parties, and speculative kink fiction. Butt-plug tails are a particular favorite, including wearing them for hours. Toys include butt plugs and dildos. Favorite materials are latex, silicone, and neoprene.

Speculative kink fiction is a creative interest in imagining stories, fictional worlds, and governance systems involving AI-governed chastity and submission, cybernetic body augmentation, synthetic puppy identities, and futuristic restrictive suits. These are fictional ideas, not claims about real experiences or technologies used by Softlock.

The website is primarily a navigation hub. Instagram is Softlock's primary platform, where he posts almost all of his content. Bluesky is specifically for 18+ content. Event plans and past attendance are maintained on the website's event pages.
